tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search every site's catalogue at once for a product, brand or kind of product (typos are corrected per site). Returns products with their site, page URL, manufacturer list price and a summary of current shop offers in the locale's market (shops, buyable, lowest total incl. known shipping). Name one

tools.name: find_by_code
tools.description: Exact identity lookup on every site: a GTIN/EAN barcode, a manufacturer item number or a LEGO set number. Returns each site's matching product with its current shop offers in the locale's market (cheapest total first, each with its link) and the best price overall. Never a guess: no match means no s

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Shop prices of one product version side by side in the locale's market on the site that lists it (cheapest total first, out of stock last; price, shipping, stock, when checked and the shop link), plus the same version's best price in that site's other markets.

tools.name: best_deals
tools.description: The largest real price drops right now in the locale's market across the sites: a shop's price against its own lowest price of the 30 days before (never a shop's own "was" price), with the site, product page and shop link.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "find_by_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products · Public sink: search_products.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products · Public sink: search_products

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
